about: The 2020 Census population of the district each state legislative contest of 2024 is held in, by D3's contest id (data/state-upper/2024, data/state-lower/2024), as the Census Bureau tabulates it to the state legislative districts of the 2024 election cycle. Nothing is apportioned: a contest whose district the Bureau does not tabulate gets no figure, with the reason. The fields are described in data/README.md (data/population/).

census_cd119.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census 119th Congressional District Summary File (CD119), v. 2024-12-05: the geographic header's POP100 for state legislative districts of the 2024 election cycle (summary levels 610 and 620)
census_cd119.licence: a work of the U.S. Government (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence printed
census_cd119.note: one zip per state, its geographic header file read by pipeline/intake/census_sld_population.py (read 2026-11-07T11:46Z to 2026-11-07T11:52Z); POP100 is the 2020 Census count of 1 April 2020 ("Population Count (100%)"); each file's url and sha256 under files. Technical documentation: https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial/2020/technical-documentation/complete-tech-docs/119th-congressional-district-summary-file/2020census-119thcongressional-districts-techdoc.pdf
